Legally Blonde.notes: Used a photo camera to film this. We were allowed to film but since I didn't personally know anyone, and I wanted to practice, I decided to "hide" my camera. About 30min from the start of Act 2 to the end of "There! Right There!". Someone in my row left after that number and the lens got covered. There's a small break as my camera only films in 25-min installments. Goes in and out of focus at times. Severely blocked by heads. Sound's pretty good, used camera audio.
